title: Optimality of Separate Selling with Finite-Support Values
abstract: arXiv:2611.06101v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We characterize when separate selling is exactly revenue-optimal in multi-item auctions with additive buyers and independent, finitely supported valuations. For each item, the valuation distribution is identical across buyers, but it may differ across items. We show that, provided at least two items have a strictly positive non-top support value, separate selling is optimal for any number of buyers $n \ge 2$ if and only if top selling, which sells each item only at its highest possible value, is optimal for a single buyer. This equivalence holds under both dominant-strategy incentive compatibility and Bayesian incentive compatibility. We then characterize the optimality of top selling in the one-buyer problem through the existence of a particular class of dual flows and derive a necessary condition and several sufficient conditions on the value distributions for its optimality. translated_title: 有限支撑估值下分离销售的最优性
translated_abstract: 我们刻画了在买家具有可加性估值、估值独立且支撑有限的多物品拍卖中，分离销售何时恰好是收益最优的。对于每种物品，估值分布在所有买家之间相同，但在不同物品之间可以不同。我们证明，只要至少有两件物品具有严格为正的非最高支撑值，分离销售对任意数量 n ≥ 2 的买家都是最优的，当且仅当“最高价销售”（即每件物品仅按其最高可能价值出售）对单个买家是最优的。这一等价性在占优策略激励相容和贝叶斯激励相容两种机制下均成立。随后，我们通过一类特定对偶流的存在性刻画了单买家问题中最高价销售的最优性，并推导出估值分布满足最优性的一个必要条件和若干充分条件。这些条件揭示了一个共同的经济特征……
tldr: 本文刻画了可加买家多物品拍卖中分离销售收益最优的充要条件：只要至少两件物品存在严格为正的非最高支撑值，分离销售对任意数量买家最优当且仅当最高价销售对单个买家最优，且该等价性在占优策略与贝叶斯激励相容下均成立。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes when separate selling is exactly revenue-optimal in multi-item auctions with additive buyers: provided at least two items have strictly positive non-top support values, separate selling is optimal for any number of buyers if and only if top selling is optimal for a single buyer, and this equivalence holds under both dominant-strategy and Bayesian incentive compatibility.
